regions.merged_text: -- Fifty-two years deacon To-day. Dec Gr.
regions.full_page: -- Fifty-two years deacon To-day. Dec Gr.
regions.per_polygon: -- Fifty-two years deacon To-day. Dec Gr.

regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your wire congratulations, etc., etc. Thanks be to God Grace is at least well enough to come home. Now Grace; you must at least for a month or so, take things easy, and as much as possible avoid worry. If you were to take a six months vacation it would be the proper thing to do.
